metadata.title: The HYPERMUCHFUSS Campaign -- an undiscovered high velocity population

notes: No eligible stars. The survey targets and preliminary trajectory examples are not given individual star identifiers; the late-type B star is only described as potentially becoming unbound with an unknown proper motion (T:p7-b4), not retained as a present-day Galactic-unbound candidate. Named unbound HVSs in T:p3-b3 and T:p3-b4 are cited only as prior literature, not studied or followed up here.
